dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this machine used to forge weapons?

dialogues.speaker: Estelle
dialogues.text: That's right. I'm very proud of this one, in fact.

dialogues.speaker: Estelle
dialogues.text: After all, are machines not eminently suited to this energy-intensive work we call forging, being able to control strength and temperature precisely as they are?

dialogues.speaker: Estelle
dialogues.text: Even someone with the most ordinary of physical qualities like me can make exquisite, honed weaponry, just like those muscled smiths.
